usedFor: Shopify holds orders and products, and Ryver is where “Send Chat Message” tells your team about them.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Send Chat Message” in Ryver
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order posts to team chat, so someone can reach the customer or check stock.

watchOut: “Create Team” makes a new workroom, so keep it off “New Product” or each product creates one.
